output.title: Spacious 3-Bedroom Duplex with Wraparound Terrace in Cloche d'Or
output.description:
This newly built duplex offers 180 m² of contemporary living space in the Cloche d'Or district, a vibrant neighborhood characterized by modern office buildings, shopping centers, and parks. The residence features a distinctive double-volume living room with panoramic glazing, allowing abundant natural light and offering views onto the adjacent park.

The open-plan kitchen is equipped with integrated Siemens appliances, quartz countertops, and soft-close cabinetry, seamlessly connecting to the dining and living areas to create an inviting environment for both daily living and entertaining.

The upper floor accommodates three bedrooms, including a master suite with fitted wardrobes and direct access to a wraparound terrace. The terrace is finished with wood decking and provides views over the shopping center, benefiting from evening sun exposure.

Additional amenities include a private parking space, elevator access, and a cellar for storage. Engineered oak flooring throughout the living and sleeping areas complements the modern architectural design of the residence.

highlights.text: 180 m² duplex with double-volume living room
Wraparound terrace with wood decking and city views
Located in modern Cloche d'Or district
